question: The average weight of a class of 24 students is 35 kilograms. If the average weight increases by 400 grams when the teacher's weight is included, what is the teacher's weight?
question_ne: २४ जना विद्यार्थीहरूको कक्षाको औसत तौल ३५ किलोग्राम छ। शिक्षकको तौल समावेश गर्दा औसत तौल ४०० ग्राम बढ्छ भने शिक्षकको तौल कति रहेछ?
explanation: 24 students average 35 kg = 840 kg in total. With the teacher, 25 people average 35.4 kg = 885 kg. Teacher = 885 − 840 = 45 kg.
explanation_ne: 24 जना विद्यार्थीको औसत 35 kg भएकाले जम्मा 840 kg हुन्छ। शिक्षकसहित 25 जनाको औसत 35.4 kg भएकाले जम्मा 885 kg हुन्छ। शिक्षकको तौल = 885 − 840 = 45 kg।

question: Sanjay scored 42% marks in an exam and failed by 60 marks. If the total full marks of the exam is 750, find the minimum percentage required to pass the exam.

explanation: 42% of 750 = 315 marks. Pass mark = 315 + 60 = 375, which is 50% of 750.

question: Sonam can complete a work in 30 days and Dilip can complete the same work in 40 days. If Sonam starts the work alone and leaves after 6 days, in how many days can Dilip complete the remaining work?
question_ne: सोनाम कुनै कामलाई ३० दिनमा र दिलीप सो काम ४० दिनमा पूरा गर्न सक्छन्। यदि सोनामले एक्लै काम सुरु गरेर ६ दिन पछि छोडेमा दिलीपले सो काम बाँकी काम कति दिनमा पूरा गर्न सक्छ?
explanation: Sonam does 1/30 of the work a day; in 6 days he does 6/30 = 1/5, leaving 4/5. Dilip does 1/40 a day, so he needs (4/5) ÷ (1/40) = 32 days.
explanation_ne: सोनामले दिनमा कामको 1/30 भाग गर्छ; 6 दिनमा 6/30 = 1/5 भाग पूरा हुन्छ, 4/5 भाग बाँकी रहन्छ। दिलीपले दिनमा 1/40 भाग गर्छ, त्यसैले उसलाई (4/5) ÷ (1/40) = 32 दिन लाग्छ।

question: If 40% of one number is equal to two-thirds of another number, what is the ratio of the first number to the second number?

explanation: 40% of the first = 2/3 of the second, so first/second = (2/3) ÷ (40/100) = 5/3.

question: To gain a profit of 27.8% after giving a 10% discount, by what percentage above the cost price should the marked price of an item be fixed?
question_ne: लागतलाई १०% छुट दिएर २७.८% नाफा प्राप्त गर्नको लागि कुनै एउटा सामानको खरिद मूल्य भन्दा कति प्रतिशतले बढी त्यस सामानको अंकित मूल्य निर्धारण गर्नुपर्छ?
explanation: Let cost price = 100. Selling price after 27.8% profit = 127.8. With a 10% discount, marked price × 0.9 = 127.8, so marked price = 142 — 42% above cost.
explanation_ne: खरिद मूल्य 100 मानौं। 27.8% नाफापछि विक्री मूल्य = 127.8 हुन्छ। 10% छुटमा अंकित मूल्य × 0.9 = 127.8 भएकाले अंकित मूल्य = 142 हुन्छ — अर्थात् लागतभन्दा 42% बढी।

question: Dinesh starts walking from his home towards the east. After walking 25 metres he turns right and walks 10 metres. Then he turns right again and walks 15 metres. After that, if he has to turn right at an angle of 45 degrees and walk 30 metres, in which direction will he be going?

question: What is the average of all the numbers between 1 and 35 that are divisible by both 3 and 5?

question: If '÷' means '-', '×' means '+', '-' means '÷' and '+' means '×', which of the following equations is correct?

question: In a certain code language, 'DOWN' is written as '5@9#' and 'NAME' is written as '#6%3'. What code is used for 'MODE'?
question_ne: यदि कुनै भाषाको कोडमा 'DOWN' लाई '५@९#', 'NAME' लाई '#६%३' लेखिन्छ भने 'MODE' लाई कुन कोड प्रयोग गरिन्छ?
explanation: From DOWN = 5@9# we get D=5, O=@, W=9, N=#; from NAME = #6%3 we get N=#, A=6, M=%, E=3. So MODE = %@53.
explanation_ne: DOWN = 5@9# बाट D=5, O=@, W=9, N=# र NAME = #6%3 बाट N=#, A=6, M=%, E=3 थाहा हुन्छ। त्यसैले MODE = %@53 हुन्छ।

question: Some words translated from an artificial language are given here. On the basis of these, choose the correct answer from the options. 'hapllesh' means 'cloudburst', 'srenchoch' means 'pinball', 'resbosrench' means 'ninepin'. What does 'Cloud nine' refer to?
question_ne: यहाँ कृत्रिम भाषाबाट अनुवाद गरिएका केही शब्दहरू दिइएका छन्। तिनीहरूको आधारमा सही उत्तर विकल्पबाट छान्नुहोस्। 'hapllesh' को अर्थ 'cloudburst', 'srenchoch' को अर्थ 'pinball', 'resbosrench' को अर्थ 'ninepin' हो भने 'Cloud nine' भन्नाले कुन लाई जनाउँछ?
explanation: hapllesh = cloudburst gives hapl = cloud and lesh = burst; srenchoch = pinball gives srench = pin and och = ball; resbosrench = ninepin gives resbo = nine. So 'cloud nine' = hapl + resbo = haplresbo.
explanation_ne: hapllesh = cloudburst बाट hapl = cloud र lesh = burst; srenchoch = pinball बाट srench = pin र och = ball; resbosrench = ninepin बाट resbo = nine थाहा हुन्छ। त्यसैले 'cloud nine' = hapl + resbo = haplresbo हुन्छ।

question: In a class of 55 students, Roshani ranks 14th from the front. If 4 more students join her class and after that she falls 3 places behind her previous position, in which place from the back will Roshani now be?
question_ne: पचपन्न जना विद्यार्थीहरू भएको कक्षामा रोशनी अगाडीबाट चौधौं स्थानमा पर्ने रहिछन्। यदि उनको कक्षामा अरु चार जना विद्यार्थीहरू थप भर्ना भएपछि उनी अघिल्लो स्थान भन्दा तीन स्थान पछाडि परिछन् भने, अब रोशनी पछाडीबाट कतिऔं स्थानमा पर्दछिन् होला?
explanation: After 4 more students join, the class has 59 students. Roshani moves 3 places back from the front, so she is now 17th from the front. From the back she is 59 − 17 + 1 = 43rd.
explanation_ne: 4 जना थपिएपछि कक्षामा 59 जना हुन्छन्। रोशनी अगाडीबाट 3 स्थान पछाडि परेर अब 17औं स्थानमा छिन्। पछाडीबाट उनको स्थान 59 − 17 + 1 = 43औं हुन्छ।

question: A girl facing north turns 180 degrees anti-clockwise and then turns 225 degrees clockwise. In which direction is she facing now? Find out.
question_ne: उत्तर तर्फ फर्किरहेको एकजना केटी १८०° घडिको सुईको विपरित दिशा घुम्दछिन् र फेरि घडिको सुईको दिशामा २२५° घुम्दछिन् भने अहिले उनी कतातर्फ फर्किरहेकी होलिन्? पत्ता लगाउनुहोस्।
explanation: Facing north, a 180-degree anti-clockwise turn points her south. A further 225-degree clockwise turn from south is 180 + 225 = 405 degrees from north, i.e. 45 degrees — north-east.
explanation_ne: उत्तरतिर फर्केर 180 डिग्री घडिको सुईको विपरित दिशा घुम्दा उनी दक्षिणतिर फर्किन्छिन्। दक्षिणबाट थप 225 डिग्री घडिको सुईको दिशामा घुम्दा उत्तरबाट 180 + 225 = 405 डिग्री, अर्थात् 45 डिग्री हुन्छ — उत्तर-पूर्व।

question: The following question is based on the information given. P, Q, R, S, T and U are the names of six mango trees standing in a garden in two rows, facing north and south. Tree Q faces north and is not joined with S. Trees S and U face each other diagonally. U and R face south, while T and R face north and south respectively. explanation: U and R face south (given), T faces north, and Q faces north. The remaining tree P is in the south-facing row, so the south-facing trees are U, R and P.
explanation_ne: U र R दक्षिणतिर फर्किएका छन् (दिइएको छ), T उत्तरतिर र Q उत्तरतिर फर्किएका छन्। बाँकी रुख P दक्षिणतिर फर्किने पंक्तिमा छ, त्यसैले दक्षिणतिर फर्केका रुखहरू U, R र P हुन्।

question: What is the code for the word 'Teacher'? Find out on the basis of the information given below. 'Royal black car' is coded as M5R2, L5B1, S3C1. 'Beautiful yellow flower' is coded as M9B5, X6Y2, S6F2. 'Talent young brother' is coded as U6T2, H5Y2, S7B2.
question_ne: Teacher शब्दको कोड के हुन्छ? तलको जानकारीको आधारमा पत्ता लगाउनुहोस्। Royal black car लाई M5R2, L5B1, S3C1 को रुपमा कोड गरिन्छ। Beautiful yellow flower लाई M9B5, X6Y2, S6F2 को रुपमा कोड गरिन्छ। Talent young brother लाई U6T2, H5Y2, S7B2 को रुपमा कोड गरिन्छ।
explanation: The code for a word is the next letter after its last letter, followed by the number of letters, the first letter, and the number of vowels. Teacher: last letter R → next letter S; 7 letters; first letter T; 3 vowels (e, a, e) → S7T3.
explanation_ne: शब्दको कोड त्यसको अन्तिम अक्षरपछिको अक्षर, अक्षर संख्या, पहिलो अक्षर र स्वर संख्या मिलेर बन्छ। Teacher: अन्तिम अक्षर R → त्यसपछिको अक्षर S; ७ वटा अक्षर; पहिलो अक्षर T; ३ वटा स्वर (e, a, e) → S7T3।

question: If south-east is called north and north-east is called west, then in the same way what is west called?
question_ne: यदि दक्षिण-पूर्वलाई उत्तर भनिन्छ, उत्तर-पूर्वलाई पश्चिम भनिन्छ भने यही प्रकारले पश्चिमलाई के भन्नुपर्ला?
explanation: The directions are rotated by 225 degrees clockwise: south-east (135°) is called north (0°), north-east (45°) is called west (270°), so west (270°) is called south-east (135°).
explanation_ne: दिशाहरू २२५ डिग्री घडिको सुईको दिशामा घुमाइएका छन्: दक्षिण-पूर्व (१३५°) लाई उत्तर (०°) भनिन्छ, उत्तर-पूर्व (४५°) लाई पश्चिम (२७०°) भनिन्छ, त्यसैले पश्चिम (२७०°) लाई दक्षिण-पूर्व (१३५°) भनिन्छ।
source: Previous Year — Koshi Province 4th Level First Paper 2083-01-26

question: Find the number that comes in place of the question mark as per the pattern given. 24 : 30; 60 : ? ; 120 : 130

question: Complete the matrix. The matrix has 3 rows and 3 columns: row 1: G, O, D; row 2: M, A, N; row 3: T, ?, R. What letter replaces the question mark?
question_ne: मेट्रिक्स पुरा गर्नुहोस्। मेट्रिक्समा ३ पंक्ति र ३ स्तम्भ छन्: पहिलो पंक्ति: G, O, D; दोस्रो पंक्ति: M, A, N; तेस्रो पंक्ति: T, ?, R। प्रश्नचिन्हको ठाउँमा कुन अक्षर आउँछ?
explanation: The letter positions in each row add up to 26, 28 and 54: row 1: G(7)+O(15)+D(4)=26; row 2: M(13)+A(1)+N(14)=28; row 3: T(20)+?+R(18)=54, so ? = 16 = P. Note: the paper numbers two questions 40; this is the second of them.
explanation_ne: हरेक पंक्तिका अक्षरहरूको स्थानको योग 26, 28 र 54 हुन्छ: पहिलो पंक्ति: G(7)+O(15)+D(4)=26; दोस्रो पंक्ति: M(13)+A(1)+N(14)=28; तेस्रो पंक्ति: T(20)+?+R(18)=54, त्यसैले ? = 16 = P हुन्छ। नोट: प्रश्नपत्रमा दुईवटा प्रश्नलाई 40 नम्बर दिइएको छ; यो तीमध्ये दोस्रो हो।

question: Find the relationship in the given groups of numbers and choose the group of numbers of the same nature from the options. (9, 5, 704) (6, 2, 212)
question_ne: दिएका संख्याको समूहमा रहेको सम्बन्ध पत्ता लगाई सोही प्रकृतिको संख्याको समूह विकल्पबाट छान्नुहोस्। (९, ५, ७०४) (६, २, २१२)
explanation: The third number is the cube of the first minus the square of the second: 9³−5² = 729−25 = 704; 6³−2² = 216−4 = 212; so 8³−2² = 512−4 = 508.

question: Nina has many dogs and cats in her house. The ratio of the number of dogs to cats in her house is 1:3. If the total number of dogs and cats is 8, how many cats does Nina have?
question_ne: स्माकरहरू मन पराउने नीनाको घरमा धेरै कुकुर र बिरालोहरू छन्। उनको घरमा भएका कुकुर र बिरालोको संख्याको अनुपात १:३ छ। कुकुर र बिरालोहरूको कुल संख्या ८ भए नीनासँग कतिवटा बिरालोहरू छन्?
explanation: Dogs:cats = 1:3 and the total is 8, so cats = 8 × 3/4 = 6.
explanation_ne: कुकुर:बिरालो = 1:3 र जम्मा 8 भएकाले बिरालो = 8 × 3/4 = 6 हुन्छ।
source: Previous Year — Koshi Province 4th Level First Paper 2083-01-26

question: The table shown has 6 letters: first row A, B, C; second row D, E, F. The values of these letters are 1–6. Find the value of C on the basis of the information given. Information: 1. (B × B) ÷ B = A; 2. A + C + E = 14; 3. C, D, E, F are in decreasing order.
question_ne: देखाएको तालिकामा ६ वटा अक्षरहरू छन्। यी अक्षरहरूको मान १-६ सम्म रहेको छ। उपलब्ध जानकारीको आधारमा C को मान निकाल्नुहोस्। तालिका: पहिलो पंक्ति A, B, C; दोस्रो पंक्ति D, E, F। जानकारी: १. (B × B) ÷ B = A; २. A+C+E = 14; ३. C, D, E, F क्रमशः घट्दो क्रममा रहेका छन्।
explanation: (B×B)÷B = B, so A = B; with A+C+E = 14 and C, D, E, F in decreasing order, the values are A = B = 6, C = 5, D = 4, E = 3, so C = 5.
explanation_ne: (B×B)÷B = B भएकाले A = B हुन्छ; A+C+E = 14 र C, D, E, F घट्दो क्रममा भएकाले मानहरू A = B = 6, C = 5, D = 4, E = 3 हुन्छन्, त्यसैले C = 5 हो।
source: Previous Year — Koshi Province 4th Level First Paper 2083-01-26
